name: A Beautiful Ride to Carlisle
source:
A romantic visual novel about two girls meeting on the train.

Dana’s summer vacation has just started and she’s on her way to northern England to volunteer on an organic  farm. But she’s not expecting something wonderful to happen on the train…
translation:
一部关于两个女孩在火车上相遇的浪漫视觉小说。

达娜的暑假刚刚开始，她正前往英格兰北部的一个有机农场做志愿者。但她没想到火车上会发生什么奇妙的事情……
